internal_discovery.plain_explanation: The 13 occurrences of ق ر ض split cleanly along morphology into two populations that the Quran never internally bridges. Twelve occurrences (six verses) are a single frozen collocation: a Form IV verb (aqraDa/yuqriDu/tuqriDu) directed at ٱللَّهَ, welded to its cognate accusative قَرْضًا حَسَنًا, and in every case followed by a guaranteed amplified return — يُضَٰعِف (2:245, 57:11, 57:18, 64:17), أَجْر (57:11, 57:18, 73:20), تُرْجَعُون (2:245), تُكَفِّر/تُدْخِل (5:12), and the self-gloss تُقَدِّمُوا۟...تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ (73:20). The single remaining occurrence (18:17:12:1) is the only Form I verb: the setting sun تَّقْرِضُهُمْ ذَاتَ ٱلشِّمَالِ — it passes/veers past the sleepers to the left, with no giver, no recipient, no thing transferred, and no return. A concrete single gloss fails both ways: 'lend/advance' is nonsensical for the sun, and 'veer past' is nonsensical toward Allah. The only available unifier ('set apart / cut off a portion to a side') is either too vague to be useful or rests on an undemonstrated 'cutting' feature that no verse states, and is witnessed on the spatial side by exactly one token whose in-verse parallel (tazāwaru, z-w-r) points to lateral avoidance rather than severance. The honest result is two unbridged classes, not one nucleus.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: qrD does NOT reduce to almsgiving/plain giving: 73:20 and 5:12 place ءَاتُوا۟/ءَاتَيْتُمُ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ in the SAME verse as وَأَقْرِضُوا۟/وَأَقْرَضْتُمُ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا, keeping them distinct — the differentia of the Form-IV class is the return/restoration framing absent from a one-way gift. qrD does NOT entail an irrecoverable outlay (every Form-IV verse foregrounds it coming back multiplied/rewarded/remitted). qrD does NOT name the commodity (the object is only qualified حَسَنًا, never specified as wealth/money). The moral 'goodly' valence is carried by the adjective حَسَنًا and context, not by the root. In 18:17 the ‑هُم object is the party AVOIDED/passed-by, not a beneficiary — so 'recipient' is not a root-level entailment; and the spatial sense entails non-contact/passing-aside, never destructive cutting-into.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 18:17:12:1 (تَّقْرِضُهُمْ): at sunset the sun taqriDu-hum ذَاتَ ٱلشِّمَالِ (toward the left side), set in strict parallel with تَّزَٰوَرُ (z-w-r) at sunrise; there is no giver, no recipient, no thing transferred, and no return/amplification, and it is the sole Form I token — it breaks any single 'lend/advance' gloss and cannot be bridged to the Form-IV covenantal-loan class without importing an undemonstrated 'cutting/parting-off' nucleus that no verse states.

internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses (two constructive, one adversarial) independently converge on the same partition and the same verdict: a within-class-strong but formula-bound Form-IV loan idiom (one collocational template sampled six times, so its consistency is inflated by repetition, not broad lexical range) plus one structurally isolated Form-I spatial token, with NO Quran-internal occurrence mediating between them. Per the principles (prefer the narrowest supported account; a vague abstraction is not useful; one witness cannot establish a nucleus; same root ≠ one meaning), forcing a single root nucleus would exceed what the packet licenses. The contract mandate — when two senses have no Quran-internal bridge, choose UNRESOLVED rather than force unity — governs here, so the whole-root judgment is UNRESOLVED with the two classes reported as scoped observations inside the clusters.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Fixed Form-IV collocation «aqraDa/yuqriDu/tuqriDu ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا»: to make over to Allah a set-apart good portion, constituted as a return-bearing transfer that is restored amplified (multiplication/reward/forgiveness/expiation). resistant_deep_analysis.preliminary_note: Isolated on every discriminating axis: only Form I, only physical subject, only non-loan sense, only occurrence with no recipient/transfer/return, and the only one whose object is the passed-by entity rather than a beneficiary. A single, structurally isolated datum cannot establish a root nucleus, and it resists the dominant transactional account entirely; its own force ('veer/pass aside', read via the in-verse tazāwaru parallel) is not clearly 'severing a portion', so it also resists the thin unifier.

independent_verification: Analyst A, Analyst B, and Adversary C independently reached the same partition (12-token Form-IV loan idiom + isolated Form-I 18:17) and the same UNRESOLVED/RESISTANT whole-root verdict; packet morphology (qac_verb_form IV vs null; qac_pos N vs V) confirms the split.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 13 confirmed occurrences: 12 in the fixed «Form-IV + cognate قَرْضًا حَسَنًا + divine object + amplified return» collocation across 2:245, 57:11, 57:18, 5:12, 64:17, 73:20; 1 (18:17:12:1) of the setting sun passing the sleepers ذَاتَ ٱلشِّمَالِ.
layer_attribution.derivation: Form IV (causative/factitive) governs all 12 loan tokens (verbs plus their cognate-accusative nouns); the single Form I verb (qac_verb_form=null) is 18:17. Morphology co-varies exactly with the semantic split; the Form I→IV derivation is morphologically clean but semantically opaque (the attested base sense does not transparently yield 'hand over a portion').
layer_attribution.lexical_class: Class A is best read as a lexicalized/formula-bound collocational sense, not a broadly productive family; Class B is an unassimilated Form-I singleton. Neither licenses a root-wide lexical class.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Return/amplification framing in Class A comes from result-clauses (يُضَٰعِف, أَجْر, تُكَفِّر, تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ); the spatial reading of 18:17 comes from the in-verse tazāwaru (z-w-r) parallel and ذَاتَ ٱلشِّمَالِ. These contextual/narrative cues gloss the scene and must not be elevated into the root's own meaning.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: No reconciliation across classes was achievable: the strongest unifier ('set apart / cut off a portion to a side') was considered and rejected as either too vague or resting on an undemonstrated, source-policy-barred 'cutting' feature. The classes are held apart rather than forced.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: 18:17:12:1 persistently resists both the dominant transactional account and the abstract unifier, and Class A resists any physical passing/cutting account; with no bridging occurrence, the whole-root nucleus remains UNRESOLVED.

hard_cases.reason: The sole Form-I token and the sole non-transactional occurrence; it is the seam the root cannot cross — it resists the 12/13 covenantal-loan account and resists the abstract 'parting-off' unifier, leaving the whole-root judgment unresolved.

evidence_basis.statement: 18:17:12:1 (تَّقْرِضُهُمْ): at sunset the sun taqriDu-hum ذَاتَ ٱلشِّمَالِ (toward the left side), set in strict parallel with تَّزَٰوَرُ (z-w-r) at sunrise; there is no giver, no recipient, no thing transferred, and no return/amplification, and it is the sole Form I token — it breaks any single 'lend/advance' gloss and cannot be bridged to the Form-IV covenantal-loan class without importing an undemonstrated 'cutting/parting-off' nucleus that no verse states.

hard_case_representation.rationale: The root is reported as two unbridged classes; the resistance at 18:17 persists after all three lenses, so it is recorded as a RESISTANT_SEAM rather than resolved. No universal nucleus is claimed, hence no evidence-derived unity to persist.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quran-internal occurrence is found that actually bridges the partition between the Form-IV «ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا» loan class and the Form-I spatial 18:17 use — e.g. a token where a single sense demonstrably yields both the advance-with-return and the passing-to-a-side reading, or where 'parting off a portion' is stated in a loan verse — such that the two classes could be merged under one demonstrated nucleus.
rejection_condition.search_location: The six loan verses (2:245, 57:11, 57:18, 5:12, 64:17, 73:20) re-read for any 'severance/parting-off a portion' language, and 18:17 re-read against its tazāwaru (z-w-r) parallel for any transfer/return semantics; plus any morphologically related qrD form outside the packet if the corpus is extended.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Check whether the candidate bridging sense is asserted by the verse's own wording and argument structure (subject, object, cognate accusative, result clause), not inferred from lexicon or etymology; require the shared feature to be present on BOTH sides.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Exclude imported classical 'cut off' etymology (barred by source policy); do not count the z-w-r parallel as a gloss of qrD's root meaning; do not treat cognate-accusative repetition as independent witnesses; discount the 'goodly' adjective and neighbouring zakāt as sources of the root's own content.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If no such bridging occurrence exists, the single-nucleus claim stays refuted and the root remains UNRESOLVED as two classes; if one is found, reopen and re-run with a candidate root-wide nucleus tested for distinctiveness and falsifiability.

reopen_conditions: If a corpus extension surfaces any qrD occurrence where the object of the Form-IV loan verb is a human recipient (not ٱللَّهَ), or where قَرْض appears without the return/amplification frame, re-test whether the loan class is truly 'return-bearing' and whether it is a formula vs a productive sense.
